intro: Valormok is a remote Horde outpost established in the rugged northwest reaches of Azshara. Positioned north of the Haldarr Encampment, this windswept settlement serves as a staging ground for scouts and adventurers braving the cursed, ancient ruins of the coast.

p: Perched among the autumn-colored trees of Azshara, Valormok represents the Horde's tentative interest in a hostile and largely forsaken territory. Life here is bleak and fraught with peril; the camp is lightly fortified and constantly exposed to nearby satyrs, nagas, and prowling beasts. Despite these hardships, its stationed warriors hold the ground, acting as a crucial flight hub and forward bastion connecting Orgrimmar with the wilder stretches of northern Kalimdor.
